_comment: Named address ranges of the Mirror's Edge (USA, default.xex) image for the inventory. kind: library = statically linked SDK code, replaced as a unit by Any360 (not decompiled); middleware = third-party engine code the title links (PhysX): neither the title's own code nor something Any360 provides, so it stays recompiled or is replaced by the vendor's library for the target, never decompiled function by function; everything else is the game's own code (Unreal Engine 3 and Mirror's Edge). Evidence (tools/library_ranges.py over titles/mirrorsedge/library_evidence.json): functions with the same instructions in the other titles' library ranges, the system calls a window makes and the strings it refers to (D3DX: ShaderDump and the shader compiler's messages; XGraphics: its xgraphics/ucode source paths; PhysX: PhysicsSDK messages; libpng and zlib: their messages). Each range runs from the first to the last proven function of its window.
